blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The prosecution could not have decided at the outset of Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s impeachment trial to focus solely on unexplained wealth, as the financial documents that ultimately led to the narrowing of the case were obtained only after prolonged legal disputes and compliance with court-issued subpoenas. House private prosecutor and trial spokesperson Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. said the decision to withdraw three impeachment articles came after prosecutors examined banking records and other financial documents that were unavailable when the proceedings began. “But we have to explain, it was not possible to make that decision at the […]...
